Workspace.title: Workspace Data
Workspace.description: Consolidated workspace records for a single constructor or construction corporate administrator.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

finance.description: Finance entries tracking project revenues and expenses.

meetings.description: Minutes of context and site coordination meetings.

photos.description: Site progressive scans and bill invoice attachments.

updatedAt.description: Server tracking timestamp of the last database modification.

Backup.title: Cloud Backup Snapshot
Backup.description: Historical backup entity stored directly in Firestore for users utilizing Cloud Backup mode.

createdTime.description: The precise timestamp of backup registration

isChunked.description: Whether the backup payload is split across multiple documents to avoid 1MB limit

numChunks.description: Total count of chunks written under subcollection

data.description: The consolidated workspace database object (only populated if not chunked)

BackupChunk.title: Cloud Backup Payload Chunk
BackupChunk.description: Individually segmented string fragments of stringified workspace JSON to prevent document size exhaustion.

index.description: Segment order number starting at zero

payload.description: Sub-string piece of serialized JSON backup data

/workspaces/{userId}.description: Real-time construction operational database node scoped specifically to each authenticated user.

/workspaces/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: User-authored snapshot file records saved to Firebase for quick recovery and offline migrations.

/workspaces/{userId}/backups/{backupId}/.description: Sub-payload piece representing a portion of the serialized workspace state database.
